property_summary: After any valid init call, USDV must point to the USDV token address, not to the vault address; the bug sets USDV to the vault, which can be detected by reading the public USDV getter.
change_summary: Change `USDV = _usdv;` to `USDV = _vault;` so USDV is set to the vault address instead of the intended USDV token address.
